SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

10. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.

11. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

12. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Nairobi

2. C — Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. A — Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Plan income and spending wisely

10. A — Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Physical features in the County; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Seasons in the County; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Historic Built Environments in the County; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Interdependence of people; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
